flavor.text: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.
Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.
It tries to resist being swallowed by a bird Pokémon by spinning the sepals on its head. It’s usually a fruitless attempt.
Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it’s not intelligent enough to care.
Although it’s too sugary for human consumption, Bounsweet’s sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.
A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

abilities.name: Leaf Guard
abilities.description: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.

abilities.name: Oblivious
abilities.description: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.

abilities.name: Sweet Veil
abilities.description: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.
